summary: Vernal Capital Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K to report the consummation of its initial public offering of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, raising $100 million. Each unit consists of one ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth of a share post-business combination. The filing includes standard IPO-related agreements (underwriting, rights, sponsor letter). This is a routine SPAC IPO closing, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or management change is involved.
